proposed_experiments.name: carry_depth_oracle_exhaustive_width1_2
proposed_experiments.description: Independently compute carry depth via prefix-sum indicator: for j in 1..=width, c_j = ((a % 10^j) + (b % 10^j) >= 10^j) as u8; depth = longest run of 1s in c_1..c_width. Compare against generator's reported depth for all a,b in 0..10^width for width 1 and 2. Must match exactly, including width1 9+1 -> 1 and width4 9999+1 -> 4.

proposed_experiments.name: observation_layout_and_overflow_first
proposed_experiments.description: For a known record, assert observation[0..width] == zero-padded a, observation[width] == '+', observation[width+1..2*width+1] == zero-padded b, observation[2*width+1] == '=', observation[2*width+2..2*width+2+width+1] are all '?', mask true exactly there, and targets at those indices equal the zero-padded sum with the overflow digit at the FIRST query index.
proposed_experiments.expected: all assertions hold; overflow digit at first query

proposed_experiments.name: per_split_per_depth_counts
proposed_experiments.description: Build with width=1, depths=[0,1], count_per_depth=100. Assert each of Train/Validation/Test has exactly 100 rows for depth 0 and 100 for depth 1, or a clean exhaustion error. Assert no split is short due to post-hoc bucketing.

proposed_experiments.name: split_ownership_swap_invariance
proposed_experiments.description: For canonicalized operands (a,b) and (b,a), assert split_for is identical and the record ID is identical. Assert split_for is seed-independent (same across seeds) and that changing seed does not move a canonical pair across splits.
proposed_experiments.expected: identical split and ID for swapped operands; seed-independent split

proposed_experiments.name: position_prior_no_depth_leakage
proposed_experiments.description: Fit position prior on train only. Evaluate on validation. Assert the prior table is indexed by position only (not depth). Swap depth labels in validation and assert predictions are unchanged.

proposed_experiments.name: malformed_corpus_rejects_not_panics
proposed_experiments.description: Feed corpora with: wrong schema, seed mismatch, width out of bounds, operand out of bounds, bad ID, bad split, bad depth, non-ASCII observation, mask not exactly '?' positions, wrong oracle targets, empty panel. Assert each returns Err, not panic.

proposed_experiments.description: Run the example with unknown dash args, missing OUTPUT.json, and extra args. Assert rejection before any computation and that output is created with create_new (never overwrites).
